stq.review: I did my last semester eco under stq sir. His biggest problem is that he comes very late to class.Not much details are taught in the class. Question ektu tricky kore. Effort dite hoi onek

Stq Sir is one of the best faculties of Eco104. I was very sceptical while taking this course since I haven't read economics at all before. He is very easygoing; he teaches well, and his slides are very straightforward as well. You just need to focus on his lectures, and you are good to go. And most importantly, his quiz and mid-question are very easy, but for the final, you need to have a good grasp of the topics because they are conceptual.
Review by Reefa Shehnil
